fire: Palisades Fire, Los Angeles County, California
reseeding: Every window re-seeds from the observed FIRMS footprint at its own seed pass, never from the previous prediction. These are 4 independent ~12 h forecasts, not one 46 h run.
perimeter: NIFC's final perimeter is the whole 23,448-acre fire over three weeks. Reference context, not the target these windows are scored against.
